name: Chigwell Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Chigwell Methodist Church. Open Tue 12-2pm and Fri 10am-12pm. Referral required.

name: Epping Forest District Allotments
short_description: Epping Forest District Council allotment sites
image: and Buckhurst Hill. Plots from £35/year. Waiting lists operate. Includes water access and storage facilities.

name: Chigwell Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden at Grange Farm. Grows seasonal vegetables and soft fruits with surplus shared among volunteers. Therapeutic gardening sessions Wednesdays.
